name: Southwest Institute of Fluid Physics

supervisors: China Academy of Engineering Physics (per the Canadian and US lists)

evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list and the US Entity List both name the Southwest Institute of Fluid Physics among the known aliases of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP), which the US Commerce Department describes as the technology complex responsible for the research, development and testing of China’s nuclear weapons; the Entity List places CAEP’s named institutes in or near Mianyang. CAEP’s page on the shock wave and detonation physics key laboratory that its Institute of Fluid Physics hosts says the laboratory does basic research for nuclear-weapon and conventional-warhead design and weapons effects, and has led experiments that supply key data for China’s nuclear-weapon physics design.

The institute hosts CAEP’s national defence science and technology key laboratory of shock wave and detonation physics, accepted in 1993 as China’s first such laboratory to enter operation, which reports 396 defence research projects.
